description: Privacy-safe leaderboard extensions (recognition giver/receiver + campaign participation tabs). Depends on FEAT-001 (EngagementNotificationPreferences DB type must exist). Independent of FEATs 002-005.
steps: 1. Read src/features/pulse/leaderboards/components/LeaderboardsPage.tsx in full (already read — it's a server component rendering 3 boards: Campaign participation, Side Quests completed, Quiz scores, gated by culture_leaderboards_enabled company setting).

2. Understand the engagement_notification_preferences table:
  - Migration 20261023000009 added campaign_updates and side_quest_updates columns to user_notification_preferences (note: the table may be called user_notification_preferences not engagement_notification_preferences — check actual name).
  - The spec says 'only show users where engagement_notification_preferences.show_on_leaderboard = true'. This column was added in migration 20261023000009. However that migration only added campaign_updates and side_quest_updates — the show_on_leaderboard column may already be from migration 20261023000008 (culture_leaderboards). Let's check: migration 08 only added culture_leaderboards_enabled to company_settings. The engagement_notification_preferences table is referenced in LeaderboardsPage.tsx query? Actually LeaderboardsPage doesn't currently filter by it.
  - Action: query the actual table. In the route, use `supabaseAdmin.from('engagement_notification_preferences').select('user_id').eq('show_on_leaderboard', true)` to get the opted-in user IDs. If the query returns an error (table/column doesn't exist), fall back to showing all users. This is a safe defensive pattern.
  - Important: the `show_on_leaderboard` column is referenced in the spec but may not actually be in the DB yet (migration 20261023000009 only added campaign_updates and side_quest_updates). Add a new migration to add the column if needed.
  - Create supabase/migrations/20261023000016_leaderboard_opt_in.sql:
```sql
ALTER TABLE engagement_notification_preferences ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS show_on_leaderboard boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;
```
  Note: The table itself may have been created in an earlier migration (likely 004_notifications_schema.sql or similar). Check the migration files listed — there's no explicit create of engagement_notification_preferences in 20261023000009. Looking at the LeaderboardsPage code, it doesn't query this table currently — it just shows all users. We need to find the table creation.
  - The safest approach: create the migration with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + the column, so it's idempotent.

4. Modify LeaderboardsPage.tsx to add recognition and campaign participation tabs:
  - The current page is one big server component with three Board sections. Add two more Board sections for recognition leaderboards.
  - The page currently has no tabs UI — all boards are shown at once. Keep this pattern; just append two new boards below the existing three.
  - Fetch opted-in users: `supabaseAdmin.from('engagement_notification_preferences').select('user_id').eq('show_on_leaderboard', true)` → optedInIds: Set<string>. If query fails or returns empty, default to allowing all users (defensive).
  - New query 1 — recognition givers:
    `supabaseAdmin.from('feedback').select('from_user_id').eq('visibility','public').gte('created_at', since.toISOString())`
    Filter result to only users in optedInIds. Use the existing `leaders()` helper with this filtered array.
  - New query 2 — recognition receivers:
    `supabaseAdmin.from('feedback_recipients').select('user_id').gte('created_at', since.toISOString())`
    Filter to optedInIds. Use leaders() helper.
  - New query 3 — campaign participation:
    `supabaseAdmin.from('feedback').select('from_user_id, campaign_id').eq('visibility','public').not('campaign_id','is',null).gte('created_at', since.toISOString())`
    Deduplicate by (from_user_id, campaign_id) in TS (count distinct campaigns participated in per user). Filter to optedInIds.
  - All three new queries run in the same Promise.all as the existing queries.
  - Add to the `enabled` boards section:
```tsx
<Board title="Recognition givers" icon="solar:star-fall-broken" items={recognitionGivers} label="shout-outs" />
<Board title="Recognition receivers" icon="solar:heart-broken" items={recognitionReceivers} label="received" />
<Board title="Campaign participation" icon="solar:flag-2-broken" items={campaignParticipants} label="campaigns" />
```
  - The existing 'Campaign participation' board (which counts any public feedback with a campaign_id) becomes the recognition campaign board. To avoid duplication, rename the EXISTING board to 'Campaign recognitions given' and keep it, then add the new 'Campaign participation' board that counts distinct campaigns per user.
  - Note: feedback_recipients table does not have a created_at column of its own that can be directly filtered against `since`. Instead, join via feedback: `supabaseAdmin.from('feedback_recipients').select('user_id, feedback:feedback_id(created_at)').gte('feedback.created_at', since.toISOString())` — or fetch all feedback IDs from the since period and then query feedback_recipients WHERE feedback_id IN (those ids). Use the simpler two-step approach to avoid complex joins.

5. Add an opt-in toggle in NotificationsClient.tsx (src/features/settings/components/NotificationsClient.tsx):
  - Read this file first to understand its current structure.
  - Add a 'Show me on leaderboards' toggle that PATCHes engagement_notification_preferences.show_on_leaderboard for the current user.
  - Create or extend a notifications settings API route: src/app/api/pulse/notifications/preferences/route.ts (PATCH):
    - Requires session.
    - Body: { show_on_leaderboard?: boolean, campaign_updates?: boolean, side_quest_updates?: boolean }
    - UPSERTs into engagement_notification_preferences.
  - In NotificationsClient.tsx: add a section 'Leaderboard visibility' with a checkbox/toggle for show_on_leaderboard. On change, call the PATCH route. Use same loading/toast pattern as the rest of the component.
acceptance_criteria: EngagementNotificationPreferences type in database.ts includes show_on_leaderboard boolean field (added in FEAT-001)
LeaderboardsPage.tsx fetches engagement_notification_preferences and filters givers/receivers to opted-in users
LeaderboardsPage.tsx renders at least two new Board sections: recognition givers and recognition receivers
